BOROUGH OF ATLANTIC HIGHLANDS 
COUNTY OF MONMOUTH
RESOLUTION 036-2025
AWARDING ENGINEERING SERVICES FOR IMPROVEMENTS 
TO UPPER PROSPECT WALL – TEMPORARY REPAIRS
WHEREAS, the Borough Engineer, Administrator and DPW Director agree that the Upper Prospect Road 
Wall is in need of immediate repairs; and
WHEREAS, a cost proposal dated January 13, 2025 from CME is broken down into 1) Survey and Base 
Map Services - $18,000, 2) Geotechnical Phase Services - $15,000 and 3) Design and Preparation of 
Emergency Temporary Repair Plans and Specification Services - $28,000 for a total cost of $61,000; and
WHEREAS, the scope of this proposal is associated with temporary repairs only, design for the full scope 
of the repairs will be submitted at a later date.  
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Governing Body of the Borough of Atlantic Highlands, in 
the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey that the proposal as outlined above in the amount of 
$61,000 be awarded to CME for the Improvements to Upper Prospect Wall – Temporary Repairs project.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that Ricardo Llanos, CMFO, certifies that funds are available for this work 
using account #02-213-40-700-001.
Motion: Approve Resolution Moved by Councilman Colasurdo; Seconded by Councilwoman Forbes
Vote: Motion carried by roll call vote (summary: Yes = 5).
Yes: Councilman Colasurdo, Councilwoman Cusack, Councilman Dougherty, Councilwoman Forbes, Councilman Pujols
No: None
Abstain: None
Absent: Councilman Crowley
I, Michelle Clark, Municipal Clerk of the Borough of Atlantic Highlands, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey, hereby 
certifies this to be a true copy of the action of the Governing Body, at its Regular Meeting held February 3, 2025. WITNESS my 
hand this 4th day of February 2025.
Michelle Clark, Municipal Clerk
